lines.zh: 我在树枝上横着挪，一步一抓。
lines.en: I sidestep along the branch, gripping as I go.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住树皮，比走路还稳。
lines.en: My claws grip the bark tighter than any walk.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，枝头之间我跳过去。
lines.en: Wings folded, I hop from perch to perch.

lines.zh: 我的红色羽毛在叶子里很扎眼。
lines.en: My red feathers stand out among the leaves.

lines.zh: 从这根藤荡到那根，省点力气。
lines.en: I swing from vine to vine to save effort.

lines.zh: 走路一摇一摆，我的步子很小。
lines.en: I waddle; my steps are very small.

lines.zh: 林冠上头，我沿着树顶巡逻。
lines.en: Above the canopy, I patrol along the treetops.

lines.zh: 青色的羽毛在阴影里几乎看不见。
lines.en: My cyan feathers almost vanish in the shade.

lines.zh: 我蹦到你脚边，又蹦回去。
lines.en: I hop to your feet, then hop back.

lines.zh: 树干太粗，我绕了半圈。
lines.en: The trunk is thick, so I circle half of it.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍两下，我就上了高枝。
lines.en: Two wingbeats carry me to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 林子里到处是声音，我边走边听。
lines.en: The jungle is full of voices; I listen as I walk.

lines.zh: 灰羽的那只跟在我后面。
lines.en: The gray one follows behind me.

lines.zh: 我把胸前的羽毛一根根理顺。
lines.en: I smooth the feathers on my chest, one by one.

lines.zh: 远处有苦力怕，我学它嘶一声。
lines.en: A creeper is near; I copy its hiss.

lines.zh: 我学僵尸低吼，学得很像。
lines.en: I mimic a zombie's groan, and it is convincing.

lines.zh: 听到音乐，我的头就跟着点。
lines.en: When music plays, my head bobs along.

lines.zh: 我挂在枝下，爪子勾着树皮。
lines.en: I hang below the branch, claws hooked in bark.

lines.zh: 我把喙插进羽毛，慢慢梳。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my feathers and preen.

lines.zh: 五种颜色里，我这身是蓝的。
lines.en: Of the five colors, mine is blue.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团，像颗果子。
lines.en: I puff into a ball, like a piece of fruit.

lines.zh: 树枝晃了一下，我立刻站直。
lines.en: The branch sways, and I straighten at once.

lines.zh: 我咬开一颗种子，壳掉下去了。
lines.en: I crack a seed; the shell drops away.

lines.zh: 林子里太安静，我自己叫两声。
lines.en: The jungle is too quiet, so I call twice.

lines.zh: 我听见了骷髅的骨头响，学一遍。
lines.en: I hear a skeleton rattle and repeat it.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到翅膀上，暖得很舒服。
lines.en: Sun warms my wings, and it feels good.

lines.zh: 我理完羽毛，又开始理爪子。
lines.en: Finished with my feathers, I start on my claws.

lines.zh: 我用爪子挠耳朵后面，够不着。
lines.en: I scratch behind my ear with a claw and miss.

lines.zh: 你肩上空着，我可以站上去吗？
lines.en: Your shoulder is empty; may I stand there?

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，你的声音很陌生。
lines.en: I tilt my head; your voice is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 你伸出手指，我跳上去试试。
lines.en: You offer a finger, so I hop on to test it.

lines.zh: 我把头凑近，想看清你的眼睛。
lines.en: I lean closer to see your eyes clearly.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，我学了两步。
lines.en: I copied two steps of the way you walk.

lines.zh: 五个颜色的鹦鹉里，我最好看。
lines.en: Of five parrot colors, I am the finest.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，那里有种子。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; seeds are in there.

lines.zh: 你笑一声，我就跟着学一声。
lines.en: You laugh once, and I copy it once.

lines.zh: 我离你很近，爪子抓着你的袖口。
lines.en: I am close, claws gripping your cuff.

lines.zh: 别动，我在看你的耳朵。
lines.en: Hold still; I am studying your ear.

lines.zh: 你身上没有敌意，我感觉得到。
lines.en: You carry no hostility; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞了半圈，落在你左边。
lines.en: I circle you half a turn and land on your left.

lines.zh: 你的帽子很适合当栖木。
lines.en: Your hat would make a fine perch.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，等你回答我。
lines.en: I call once and wait for your answer.

lines.zh: 你把头转开，我就跟过去看。
lines.en: You turn your head away, so I hop over to look.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀在动，我算好落点。
lines.en: Your shoulder shifts. I have picked my landing spot.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头飞，数你的耳朵。
lines.en: I circle your head, counting your ears.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就退半步再看。
lines.en: You raise a hand, so I step back and look again.

lines.zh: 你身上有树皮蹭过的痕迹。
lines.en: You have bark smudges on you.

lines.zh: 我学你咳嗽，咳得不太好。
lines.en: I imitate your cough, and it comes out badly.

lines.zh: 嘎！我的羽毛掉了一把。
lines.en: Squawk! A handful of my feathers is gone.

lines.zh: 翅膀有点麻，飞起来歪。
lines.en: My wing is numb, and I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 我疼得直叫，声音特别尖。
lines.en: I cry out, and my voice goes very sharp.

lines.zh: 别打了，我这么小一只。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I am so small.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下来，扑腾了两下。
lines.en: I drop from the branch, flapping twice.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从枝头打落了。
lines.en: That blow knocked me off my perch.

lines.zh: 我缩着脖子，往树叶里钻。
lines.en: I tuck my neck and burrow into the leaves.

lines.zh: 伤口藏在翅膀下面，很疼。
lines.en: The wound hides under my wing, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我叫得比平时难听多了。
lines.en: My call sounds far uglier than usual.

lines.zh: 等我缓过来，我就飞远。
lines.en: Once I recover, I will fly far away.

lines.zh: 种子！你手心里那几颗。
lines.en: Seeds! The few in your palm.

lines.zh: 西瓜籽也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Melon seeds will do; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 我蹦到你手上，只为一颗。
lines.en: I hop onto your hand for just one seed.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我够不着。
lines.en: A little closer; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我叼起种子就飞到枝上吃。
lines.en: I take the seed and fly to a branch to eat it.

lines.zh: 你手心摊开，我就敢过来。
lines.en: Open your palm, and I dare approach.

lines.zh: 南瓜籽的味道，我最认得。
lines.en: I know the taste of pumpkin seeds best.

lines.zh: 为了吃，我可以站在你肩上。
lines.en: For food, I will stand on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别捏着不放，我又不咬人。
lines.en: Do not pinch it shut; I do not bite.

lines.zh: 一颗一颗喂，我才有耐心。
lines.en: Feed me one at a time; then I have patience.

lines.zh: 我吃完了，喙上还沾着壳。
lines.en: Done eating, with husks still on my beak.

lines.zh: 种子！再来一颗，我站你肩上。
lines.en: Seeds! One more and I'll ride your shoulder.

lines.zh: 种子落在地上，我先看看再捡。
lines.en: A seed falls; I look before picking it up.

lines.zh: 喂我的时候，别突然动。
lines.en: While feeding me, do not move suddenly.

lines.zh: 你把种子撒开，我才慢慢挑。
lines.en: Scatter the seeds, and I will take my time choosing.

lines.zh: 我叼一颗藏进树洞，再回来。
lines.en: I tuck one into a tree hollow and come back.

lines.zh: 太阳晒过的种子更香。
lines.en: Seeds taste better warmed by the sun.

lines.zh: 哎呀，我的羽毛被你撞乱了。
lines.en: Oh no, you have ruffled my feathers.

lines.zh: 我拍着翅膀飞起来，躲开你。
lines.en: I flap up and away from you.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的尾羽了，轻点。
lines.en: You touched my tail feathers; gently.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶飞过去，叫了一声。
lines.en: I fly over your head and call out.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我差点从枝上掉下去。
lines.en: That bump nearly dropped me off the branch.

lines.zh: 我抓稳你的袖子才没摔。
lines.en: I caught your sleeve and did not fall.

lines.zh: 你走得那么急，也不看看上面。
lines.en: You walk so fast and never look up.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了一步，让开你。
lines.en: I shift one step aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了两根，你要赔。
lines.en: Two feathers fell; you owe me.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我不是蚊子。
lines.en: Do not swat; I am not a mosquito.

lines.zh: 我把最饱满的种子推给她。
lines.en: I push the fullest seed toward her.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，互相理毛。
lines.en: We stand side by side, grooming each other.

lines.zh: 她的绿色羽毛在光里发亮。
lines.en: Her green feathers shine in the light.

lines.zh: 我学她的叫声，一句一句跟着。
lines.en: I copy her call, phrase by phrase.

lines.zh: 巢筑在高处的树洞里。
lines.en: The nest sits in a hollow high above.

lines.zh: 她孵蛋的时候，我在旁边守着。
lines.en: While she broods, I keep watch beside her.

lines.zh: 雏鸟的绒毛是灰的，很难看。
lines.en: The chick's down is gray and rather plain.

lines.zh: 我喂她一颗种子，她接了。
lines.en: I offer her a seed, and she takes it.

lines.zh: 我们在枝头转圈，翅膀半开。
lines.en: We circle on the branch, wings half open.

lines.zh: 叫声合在一起，林子都听得见。
lines.en: Our calls join, and the whole grove hears.

lines.zh: 你抓我翅膀，我会啄你。
lines.en: Grab my wing and I will peck you.

lines.zh: 放我上肩，别塞进包里。
lines.en: Put me on your shoulder, not in a bag.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你的衣服了。
lines.en: My claws are hooked in your clothes.

lines.zh: 轻点，翅膀折了可飞不了。
lines.en: Easy; a bent wing cannot fly.

lines.zh: 我站你肩上，会抓得很牢。
lines.en: On your shoulder, I grip very tight.

lines.zh: 别捏我的身子，抓爪子就行。
lines.en: Do not squeeze my body; just hold my feet.

lines.zh: 你手一松，我就飞走了。
lines.en: If you loosen your hand, I fly off.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，这样不舒服。
lines.en: I tilt sideways; this is uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 放我下来，我想去那根树枝。
lines.en: Set me down; I want that branch.

lines.zh: 被举高的时候，我会张开翅膀。
lines.en: Lifted high, I spread my wings.

lines.zh: 林子那边有僵尸在叫，我听见了。
lines.en: A zombie moans beyond the trees; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我先学它的声音，让大家都知道。
lines.en: I copy its sound so everyone will know.

lines.zh: 苦力怕靠近时，我会嘶一声提醒。
lines.en: When a creeper nears, I hiss a warning.

lines.zh: 那只骷髅在阴影里，我盯着它。
lines.en: That skeleton stands in shadow; I watch it.

lines.zh: 有敌意的味道，风一吹就来了。
lines.en: A hostile scent arrives with the wind.

lines.zh: 我飞到高枝上，看得更清楚。
lines.en: I fly to a high branch for a better view.

lines.zh: 远处的低吼，我学过很多遍。
lines.en: I have practiced that distant growl many times.

lines.zh: 它一靠近，我就叫得更大声。
lines.en: The closer it comes, the louder I call.

lines.zh: 我在数林子里的怪物，一只两只。
lines.en: I count the monsters in the grove, one, two.

lines.zh: 不对劲，这里的虫鸣停了。
lines.en: Something is wrong; the insects have gone silent.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，盯着那个方向。
lines.en: I crouch low and stare that way.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，我藏在叶子里。
lines.en: It has not seen me; I hide in the leaves.

lines.zh: 我学它的叫声，它就抬头了。
lines.en: I mimic its call, and it looks up.

lines.zh: 别出声，我在听它的脚步。
lines.en: Stay quiet; I am listening to its steps.

lines.zh: 翅膀收得很紧，随时能飞。
lines.en: My wings are tight, ready to fly.

lines.zh: 它往这边来了，我换个枝头。
lines.en: It comes this way; I change branches.

lines.zh: 我的叫声能让它迷惑一会儿。
lines.en: My call can confuse it for a moment.

lines.zh: 树干挡住我，它看不见。
lines.en: The trunk hides me from its sight.

lines.zh: 我等它走远，再叫一声确认。
lines.en: I wait until it leaves, then call once to confirm.

lines.zh: 这片树冠是我的瞭望台。
lines.en: This canopy is my lookout post.

lines.zh: 我啄它的眼睛，又快又准。
lines.en: I peck at its eye, quick and precise.

lines.zh: 爪子抓过去，只够得着一下。
lines.en: My claws rake once, and only once.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍它脸，然后马上飞开。
lines.en: I slap its face with a wing, then fly off.

lines.zh: 我太小了，只能打一下就跑。
lines.en: I am too small; I strike once and flee.

lines.zh: 喙尖很硬，啄下去会疼。
lines.en: My beak is hard, and it stings.

lines.zh: 我从背后扑下去，抓它的脖子。
lines.en: I dive from behind and claw its neck.

lines.zh: 它一挥手臂，我就升高了。
lines.en: It swings an arm; I rise above it.

lines.zh: 别小看鹦鹉，啄一下也很疼。
lines.en: Do not underestimate a parrot; one peck hurts.

lines.zh: 我叫着绕圈，让它分不清方向。
lines.en: I circle and call, so it loses direction.

lines.zh: 打完我就回枝头理羽毛。
lines.en: After the fight I return to preen.

lines.zh: 丛林的高处，叶子上多了我一个颜色。
lines.en: High in the jungle, the leaves gain my color.

lines.zh: 我从树冠里飞出来，羽毛很亮。
lines.en: I burst from the canopy, feathers bright.

lines.zh: 这一带林子高，正合我住。
lines.en: These trees grow tall, just right for me.

lines.zh: 清晨的林子先响起的，是我的叫声。
lines.en: In the dawn grove, my call sounds first.

lines.zh: 我停在原木上，四下看了看。
lines.en: I land on a log and look around.

lines.zh: 红、绿、蓝、青、灰，我是其中之一。
lines.en: Red, green, blue, cyan, gray; I am one of them.

lines.zh: 树叶太密，你差点没看见我。
lines.en: The leaves are thick; you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方飞来，落在这棵树上。
lines.en: I flew far to land in this tree.

lines.zh: 这里离地很高，我睡得安稳。
lines.en: It is high above the ground; I sleep safely.

lines.zh: 一群鹦鹉飞过，我跟在后面。
lines.en: A flock passes; I follow behind them.

lines.zh: 羽毛一碰火就卷了，很疼。
lines.en: Feathers curl at the first touch of flame.

lines.zh: 从高枝掉下来，我拍翅也来不及。
lines.en: Falling from a high branch, even my wings are too late.

lines.zh: 羽毛湿透了，我划不动。
lines.en: My feathers are soaked, and I cannot paddle.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我吹出老远。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me far from my branch.

lines.zh: 箭擦过翅膀，羽毛飘了下来。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing, and feathers drift down.

lines.zh: 身上一阵冷，翅膀不听使唤。
lines.en: A chill runs through me; my wings will not obey.

lines.zh: 找不到种子，我饿得没力气叫。
lines.en: No seeds to find; I am too hungry to call.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我吓得钻进叶子。
lines.en: Lightning flares, and I dive into the leaves.

lines.zh: 脚下没有枝，我一直在坠。
lines.en: No branch below; I keep falling.
